failure.summary: A user-requested correction exists and works at a side-version path, while the fixed public entry continues serving the superseded behavior and does not link to the correction.

observedSubject.requiredCorrection: Keep original 04/05 independently runnable and separate additive skeleton research.

mustNeverRepeat: Count a corrected file under a side-version directory as delivered while the fixed public entry still serves the superseded behavior.
Treat a commit subject, directory count, or successful candidate URL as proof that the canonical user entry was promoted.
Let a fixed entry inherit a correction claim without a post-promotion readback bound to the corrected identity.
Ask the user to discover or choose a hidden side-version URL as the first layer of QA.
gate: A candidate path may be CORRECTION_CANDIDATE_VERIFIED, but it is not the current delivery until the fixed public entry resolves to the corrected identity.
The fixed entry must be read back after promotion and its build marker, content identity and every correction-critical invariant must match the candidate receipt.
A fixed entry that still serves the previous build is HOLD_CANONICAL_ENTRY_STALE even when the candidate path passes.

A redirect or link is acceptable only when it is the declared fixed-entry behavior and a fresh public readback proves that users automatically reach the corrected identity; an undisclosed side link is not promotion.
Keep the previous fixed-entry identity as rollback evidence until the corrected fixed entry passes public and browser gates.
This gate does not prove reference fidelity, visual acceptance, device acceptance or user acceptance.

activation.rollbackPoint: Keep the current R21 fixed-entry identity unchanged until Haiyu promotes and independently verifies the corrected entry; remove this Candidate if it adds no discrimination beyond PUBLIC_WEB_DELIVERY_GATE.
